bestowals.vote_detail: 57.1% of 14 votes cast. The ballot credited this recognition to a real handler by name, out of character, alongside the characters that handler wrote (among them Rocko Daymon and Caitlyn Daymon, the Chronic Collizion, and Olvir Arsvinnar); the museum carries the recognition through those characters and withholds the handler's own name under the privacy rule, per the same reasoning stated for an out-of-character induction. Four further handlers were named as fellow nominees for characters including Ice Tre, "Queen of the Ring" Lindsay Troy, "Triple X" Sean Stevens and Joey Melton; none is recorded here by name.
